deploy-bot: Incoming release rc-2026.03.20 -> eu-west-1. Preflight prompt/eval gating started.

deploy-bot: SUMMARY: prompt-eval suite failed checks (required pass_rate >= 92%).
```
Total tests: 110
Pass rate: 86% (threshold 92%)
Regression types: truncation on >2048 contexts, slight safety classification drift
Top failing bucket: instruction-following long-context (8/12 fails)
Average PPL: 2.05 -> 2.27
```

sara: Thanks deploy-bot. @mike please triage. if it's runtime/quant we may narrow scope. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: On it. Running a focused bisect across kernel picks & quantization options. My hunch: the new fused-gemm path in runtime v1.10.0 changed activation scaling for quantized weights. Seeing small diff locally.

raj: If we need a quick safety fallback, we can pin routing to model-runtime v1.9.x via the routing switch. I can prepare the pin script.

emily: Product: we need to decide hotfix vs full rollback. Hotfix limited to kernel revert? or route-pin until full fix?

liz: Product approves emergency kernel-only hotfix if it fixes the suite. Prefer preserve rollout momentum.

ops-bot: NOTE: Change window open until 2367893600. Automatic rollback scheduled at 2367907200 if unresolved.

sara: Decision: HOLD the rollout. @mike open a hotfix branch hotfix/runtime-quant-236789 and run a 30m smoke + full suite. Raj prepare routing pin/playbook.

mike: PR created: GH redwood/inference#5420 - hotfix/runtime-quant-236789. Local quick-run after patch:
```
post-hotfix-local:
- pass_rate: 93%
- avg_ppl: 2.02
- failing_examples: 3/110 (edge long-context alignment)
```

mike: Kicking a small canary in staging (staging-canary eu-west-1, 5% traffic). ETA 22m for staged evals.

raj: Routing pin prepared as fallback script: /ops/routing/pin-v1.9.x.sh. Rollback playbook linked to ticket D-4702.

deploy-bot: Staging sweep running. hold=manual, canary=staging(5%). Monitoring configured: suite checks every 5m, auto-pause on >1.5% drop vs baseline.

mike: Staging results: pass_rate 92.3% across full suite. Opening deploybot clear request for staged rollout to 10%.

sara: Approve staged ramp to 10% for 15m. @ops-bot be ready to flip pin if any regression appears.

ops-bot: Standing by. Manual pin and rollback endpoints ready. :white_check_mark:

emily: I'll update release notes with a short hotfix entry and a note about continuous monitoring. Notifying support and affected partners.

liz: Also add an internal note to the changelog referencing D-4702 and GH#5420.

mike: Canary ramped to 10%. Monitoring shows stable metrics for two intervals. No safety alerts.

sara: Clear the hold and continue gradual ramp per deploy policy. Keep monitoring hooks for 1h post-full-ramp.

deploy-bot: Hold cleared at 2367890456 by manual approval. Final: hotfix applied, staged rollout healthy, full ramp in progress. Thread closed.
